Firms and development

Firms play a central role in employment, productivity, investment, innovation, and structural transformation. Differences in firm size, management, technology, finance, and market access can affect economic outcomes.

Development economics therefore increasingly studies firms directly. Understanding employer behaviour can help explain hiring, productivity, worker outcomes, and the expansion or survival of enterprises.
